Grace, saw AiDASH closed its $50M Series C and is expanding fast across Europe and ANZ.

I built a personalized signal play for AiDASH off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
